name: The miniature horses
alt: A small chestnut horse with a long flaxen mane stands beside a wooden shelter.
introduction: Small in stature, with a special place in the life of the ranch.
story:
The horses at Critter Creek give visitors a reason to pause, observe, and ask questions.

The ranch's animal-care stories explain some of the things visitors notice, including why a horse might wear a fly mask or a grazing muzzle. Learning about an animal often begins with a simple question.
care: Your support helps the ranch provide continued care for the animals on site. Ask the team about the needs you can help meet.
